name: Geography Scholar Study
body:
Associated Skill Knowledge (geography) (Int)

Basic Study Ability
Navigator (Ex)

You can substitute a Knowledge (geography) skill check for any Survival skill check. Additionally, when traveling long distances (whether by foot, by steed, or by vehicle), your expert navigation allows your party to treat their base speed as 10 feet higher than normal. Add this bonus before factoring in adjustments for terrain and other factors. (For example, if your party normally travels at a 30-foot movement rate and cover 24 miles in an 8-hour day, they would instead travel at a 40-foot movement rate and cover 32 miles in the same period. If their movement was slowed to 1/2 speed by the terrain, they would be slowed to 16 miles/day instead of 12 miles/day.) So long as the stars are visible, you and your party take no penalty to your speed while traveling at night.

Associated Technique
Repositioning Technique (Ex)

You gain a +1 bonus to your CMB on any reposition combat maneuver check made against a target you have studied with this ability, and you never provoke attacks of opportunity while using a reposition combat maneuver against that target. At 3rd level and every 3 levels thereafter, this bonus increases by 1, to a maximum of +7 at 18th level.

Advanced Study Abilities
Favored Terrain (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Navigator study ability, scholar level 3rd.

You gain the favored terrain ability, as the ranger class feature, selecting any one terrain. You gain a +2 bonus on initiative checks and on Knowledge (geography), Perception, Stealth, and Survival skill checks when you are in this terrain. This bonus stacks with the favored terrain bonus gained from other classes, such as ranger, provided you select the same terrain. When you reach 12 ranks in Knowledge (geography), this bonus increases to +4. When you reach 18 ranks, it increases to +6. When traveling through your favored terrain, you normally leave no trail and cannot be tracked (though you may leave a trail if you so choose).

Special: You can select this study ability up to two times. Each time, you must select a different terrain to which it applies.

Find Stuff (Sp)

Prerequisite(s): Navigator study ability, scholar level 2nd.

You can use know direction at will as a spell-like ability by expending 1 point of inspiration. When you reach 7 ranks in Knowledge (geography), you can use locate object by expending 2 points of inspiration.

When you reach 11 ranks in Knowledge (geography), you can use locate creature by expending 3 points of inspiration.

Meteorology (Ex/Su)

Prerequisite(s): Navigator study ability, scholar level 2nd.

Your ability to predict the weather prepares everyone in your party for the worst. You gain Endurance as a bonus feat. You can extend the benefits of this feat to your familiar or animal companion, plus one additional living traveling companion in your party for every 4 ranks you have in Knowledge (geography). (Non-living companions such as constructs and undead are not eligible targets for this ability.) Your traveling companions must remain within long range of you (400 feet + 40 feet per rank that you have in this skill) in order to continue receiving these benefits. If you are at least a 10th level scholar with 10 ranks in Knowledge (geography), you also grant the effects of endure elements to all affected individuals, including yourself; endure elements is a continuous supernatural effect.
